<li class="blockList">
<hr>
<pre>public final class <span class="typeNameLabel">MapSceneLoadOptionsBuilder</span>
extends <a href="sdk-for-android-explore-api-reference-nativebase" title="class in com.here">NativeBase</a></pre>
<div class="block"><p>Builder for creating <a href="sdk-for-android-explore-api-reference-mapsceneloadoptions" title="class in com.here.sdk.mapview"><code>MapSceneLoadOptions</code></a> instances.
 This builder ensures that either a MapScheme or a configuration file is set, but not both.
 <p>Note: This is a beta release of this feature, so there could be a few bugs and unexpected behaviors.
 Related APIs may change for new releases without a deprecation process.</div>
</li>
</ul>
</div>
